rule: Definitions below are fixed before looking at any flow-ratio outcome. Any change requires a new version and preservation of this file.

data.market: TWSE common stocks with institutional data
data.universe: daily top 500 by trailing 20-day average turnover

timing: All features use information available by T close. Outcomes enter at T+1 open and use T+k close.
primary_flow: foreign_net + trust_net; dealer excluded from the primary test because historical dealer data are not split into proprietary versus hedging

definitions.inst_amount: net shares * same-day close, same approximation as CRR v0
definitions.industry_net5: 5-trading-day sum of primary institutional amount within industry
definitions.positive_pool_share5: max(industry_net5,0) / sum(max(industry_net5,0)) across industries on T
definitions.turnover_share5: industry_turnover5 / sum(industry_turnover5) across industries on T
definitions.baseline60: mean of overalloc5 over the prior 60 trading days, shifted by one day, minimum 20 observations
definitions.outflow_pool_share5: abs(min(industry_net5,0)) / sum(abs(min(industry_net5,0))) across industries on T

outcome.industry_return_k: median constituent return from T+1 open to T+k close for k in {5,10,20}; median is used to reduce corporate-action outlier sensitivity
outcome.market_return_k: median return of the same daily top-500 universe

tests.primary: Each day rank industries with valid flow_ratio60 into quintiles. Compare Q5 versus all valid industries and report excess_5/10/20, sample days, and Newey-West t on daily cross-sectional means.
tests.monotonicity: Report Q1..Q5 forward excess and daily cross-sectional Spearman(flow_ratio60, excess_k).
tests.secondary: Repeat descriptive quintiles for overalloc5, foreign-only flow ratio, trust-only flow ratio, and outflow_overalloc5. Secondary tests cannot define PASS for v1.

pass_bar: Primary PASS only if development Q5 excess_20 > +1.0 percentage point with Newey-West t >= 2.0, and Q5 excess_20 is positive in both 2025 holdout and 2020 stress period. Also report monotonicity but do not use it to rescue a failed primary test.
anti_overfit: Do not alter 5-day flow window, 60-day baseline, quintile cut, universe, primary institution definition, or pass bar after seeing results. No threshold search in v1.
